name: player_accumulate_slope_forces
description: Player::AccumulateSlopeForces applies gravity-scaled surface-normal slope impulses from up to three above-ground probe candidates.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player post-move environment cluster pass so candidate-buffer indexing, x87 slope comparisons, and caller velocity context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42c420 validates clamping g_PlayerEnvProbe_AboveGroundCount to three samples, selecting each sample's best candidate, applying force only when surfaceNormal.y < g_Player_MaxSlope, and adding normal.x, normal.y - 1, and normal.z scaled by g_Player_DeltaTime * gravityAccel * 5 to projectileSpawnVel.
The native smoke verifies the three-sample cap, max-slope gate, best-candidate lookup, and accumulated velocity delta.
